mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with cenobamate (triazole antiepileptic) presents multiple interaction risks including potential serotonin syndrome, CNS depression, and CYP3A4-mediated metabolism alterations.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if clinically necessary, use with extreme caution, baseline psychiatric assessment, and close monitoring for serotonergic symptoms, sedation, and seizure control.
